about: Pendulum, a player of swinging notes, as a sequencer of level 5: pendulum at the end of the unit's list of sequencers, for the synth and the drum. Each key starts a swing that plays its note each time it crosses the centre, forever; the key again retriggers it. Blue quantize (press: grid), ochre gravity, grey drift (pendulum wave), red scale (press: clear all; shift+press: launch the scale); shift+key plays the instrument straight. Free time by default (shift+blue press: tempo sync); help held shows every control and setting. Its words in the firmware's letters, in placeholders of its picture pendulum.svg (pendulum.svg.make: the unit's tempo screen's head and tail around them). It keeps its three values in pendulum.bin, in a folder the computer does not see. It changes no place of the firmware and needs the base.
name: pendulum
